Record CPU, memory, and network usage over time on Linux and store it on local disk or in S3-compatible object storage.

Usage:
  smob [command]

Available Commands:
  collect     Collect metrics and write them to the configured store
  config      Print the effective configuration
  help        Help about any command
  query       Query recorded samples
  stats       Summarize samples over a time range
  tail        Follow the most recent samples
  version     Print version, commit, and build date

Flags:
      --config string       path to the YAML configuration file (default "/etc/smob/smob.yaml")
  -h, --help                help for smob
      --log-format string   log format override: text, json
      --log-level string    log level override: debug, info, warn, error
      --version             print version, commit, and build date and exit

Use "smob [command] --help" for more information about a command.
